podcast.title: Early 1990s Prime Time Success
podcast.body: Gandharvas were among the Canadian bands that achieved "prime time" attention in the early 1990s, showcasing the era's burgeoning talent. "The early 90s were pretty amazing with a long list of Canadian bands getting a shot at prime time. We had moist, the watchman, lowest of the low, sons of freedom, grapes of wrath, rhymes with orange, pure Gandarva's limb lifter."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
